styleguide.title: Style guide
styleguide.subtitle: Throwaway route. Delete once the wall is built.
app.subtagline: Give what you no longer need to someone in Coimbatore who does.
error.boundaryBody: Nothing you posted is lost. Reload and it will most likely work.
landing.heroLede: Blood, hair, breast milk or the things you no longer need — EEGAI connects you with a verified hospital or organisation near you.
landing.privacyLocation: Show anyone where you live. Your area is used to work out what is near you, and for nothing else.
landing.privacyContact: Give a hospital your number before you have said yes. That happens when you offer, and not a moment earlier.
landing.privacyMedical: Decide whether you can donate. That is between you and the institution, in person.
landing.howLede: Each kind of donation has its own path. The last step always happens with the organisation.
landing.gatesTitle: We ask before anything goes up
landing.gatesBody: A few honest questions about condition, answered before you post. An organisation has to sort whatever arrives, and a torn shirt costs them more to throw away than it was worth to send.
landing.forDonorBody: Give blood, hair or milk at a hospital near you — or post the things you no longer need.
landing.forNgoBody: Ask the donors near you for what you need, or claim what has been posted nearby.
landing.forVolunteerBody: Collect from a door near you and hand it over. Two codes, spoken aloud.
landing.trustOtp: A spoken code at both ends
landing.closing: No money changes hands. Nothing is sold. Nobody is ranked.
landing.step1Body: Blood, hair or breast milk, and the area you are in. Nothing else.
landing.step2Body: Only hospitals, blood centres and milk banks we have checked, and only within about 10 km of you.
landing.step3Body: You get the address and a number to ring. The donation happens there, with them.
auth.roleDonorHint: Give blood, hair, breast milk or material.
auth.roleNgoHint: Receive hair, breast milk or materials for the people you serve.
auth.forgotBody: Tell us your number and someone will call you to set a new one. We cannot send it by message yet.
auth.forgotSent: If that number has an account, someone will call you to reset it.
guide.title: How EEGAI works
auth.roleHospitalHint: Post blood alerts to registered donors.
auth.acceptTerms: I have read and accept the terms for hospitals.
landing.roleHospitalBody: Post a blood alert and reach every registered blood donor.
landing.roleNgoBody: Receive hair, breast milk and materials from donors near you.
landing.roleDonorBody: Give blood, hair, breast milk or the things you no longer need.
landing.roleDeliveryBody: Pick up materials from a donor's door and deliver them.
landing.typeBloodBody: Register once with your blood type. When a hospital needs blood, you are alerted and say whether you are available.
landing.typeHairBody: For wigs. Fill in a short form and choose a partner organisation.
landing.typeMilkBody: Through a Lactation Management Centre, after their screening.
landing.typeMaterialBody: Clothes, books and household things, picked up from your door by a delivery partner.
landing.note1: Every hospital, organisation and delivery partner is verified by an admin.
landing.note2: Location-based matching helps help arrive faster.
landing.note3: Your contact details are shared only after you consent.
landing.note4: EEGAI connects you. Screening is done by the organisation.
